items.example: If I were you, I'd say sorry.
items.simple: You tell someone what you would do in their place.
items.note: "If I were" — I için de "were" kullanılır.

items.example: You'd better hurry up. We're late.
items.exampleTr: Acele etsen iyi olur. Geç kaldık.
items.simple: You say this when it is smart to do something fast.
items.note: Kısaltma: had better. Sonrası yalın fiil.

items.example: You should talk to your teacher.
items.simple: You think it is a good idea for them to do it.

items.example: You shouldn't stay up so late.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar geç saate kadar uyanık kalmamalısın.
items.simple: You think it is not a good idea to do it.

items.example: You should have called me first.
items.simple: It was a good idea, but you did not do it.

items.example: You shouldn't have said that to her.
items.simple: It was not a good idea, but you did it.

items.example: What if it rains tomorrow?
items.simple: You think about something that might happen.

items.example: Why don't you ask her out?
items.simple: You give a nice, friendly idea.

items.example: How about we go for a walk?
items.simple: You give an idea and ask if the other person likes it.

items.en: If it rains, we'll stay home.
items.example: If it rains, we'll stay home.
items.simple: If one thing happens, the next thing will happen.
items.note: If'ten sonra will kullanılmaz: If it rains.

items.en: If I had more time, I'd …
items.example: If I had more time, I'd learn piano.
items.exampleTr: Daha fazla zamanım olsa piyano öğrenirdim.
items.simple: You don't have time now, but you would do it with time.

items.en: If I won the lottery, I'd …
items.example: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a boat.
items.simple: You think about something that is not real right now.

items.example: If only I had a bigger house!
items.exampleTr: Keşke daha büyük bir evim olsaydı!
items.simple: You wish for something you don't have.

items.example: I don't mind. It's up to you.
items.simple: You are the one who chooses.

items.example: Take your time. There's no rush.
items.simple: You don't need to be fast. It is okay.

items.en: It might be a good idea to …
items.example: It might be a good idea to ask first.
items.exampleTr: Önce sormak iyi bir fikir olabilir.
items.simple: A soft way to give advice.

items.example: Can I ask you for some advice?
items.simple: Words that help you know what to do.

items.example: I suggest we leave early.
items.simple: You tell someone your idea of what to do.

items.example: My dad always gives good advice.
items.simple: You tell someone what you think they should do.

items.example: I took her advice and stayed home.
items.simple: You listen to the idea and do it.

items.example: It's hard to make a decision.
items.simple: You choose one thing from many things.

items.example: Let me think it over tonight.
items.simple: You think slowly about it before you choose.

items.example: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the bus.
items.simple: If not, then something bad will happen.
